Partner with New York Logistics Experts to Grow Your Reach, Bottom Line

Delight customers with enhanced transportation logistics solutions from one of the leading freight companies in New York

Whether your organization is based on the U.S. East Coast, or half a world away,  AIT’s Long Island team is ready to help you scale. Backed by decades of experience and global infrastructure, our New York logistics professionals deliver custom transportation logistics solutions to meet your regional and international shipping needs.

As one of the most trusted New York logistics companies, we specialize in home delivery, retail fulfillment, and global freight forwarding from Long Island to anywhere in the world. Our full suite of services include:

  • Comprehensive air, ground, sea, and intermodal door-to-door services
  • Concierge, white glove delivery options
  • Warehouse management expertise
  • Simple software integration
  • In-house customs brokerage and Wheels Up customs clearance program
  • And much more!

Building Entrance

The Docks

The Team Volunteering

At AIT, our business is supply chain solutions. We're a freight forwarder, yes—but we're much more than that.

For customers looking for New York logistics companies, and all our clients all around the world, we act as a transportation services liaison—a deeply experienced and connected access point to a worldwide network of professionals and resources.

Our reach and expertise spans across every cargo channel and method, from air to sea to road to rail. And our collection of logistics support services includes a mix of offerings shippers won't find anywhere else, including insurance, advanced technology integrations, in-house customs brokerage, and more.
Our talented team of freight forwarders on Long Island is part of a global network that creates transportation logistics solutions every day for nearly every industry, with a strong local focus on home delivery.
Since 2001, our team on Long Island has served some of the largest retailers and e-commerce companies in the world as part of Select Express & Logistics. So, whether you're shipping to a single-family home, a warehouse, or a store, they'll work with you to develop a creative, flexible logistics solution that will give you an edge in today's highly competitive landscape. Their comprehensive list of retail and residential delivery services include:
  • Threshold
  • Room of choice
  • White glove
  • In-home/In-store assembly
  • Dedicated vehicles
  • On-demand local couriers
Yes! Our expanding footprint currently includes more than 150 facilities across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and North America.

In New York state, you’ll find AIT’s specialized Life Sciences team, our Syracuse freight forwarding team, and our home delivery logistics team serving the broader metro region.

AIT is a member of the Transport Asset Protection Association, and all of AIT's North American locations feature multiple, advanced safety and security features, including 24-hour monitoring, closed-circuit cameras, keypad access and a driver check-in and escort policy.
